shortDescription: Ensure Incus image from file or URL

options.name: alias
options.description: Primary alias for the image on the local server. Used to check existence and as the first alias assigned on import.

options.name: aliases
options.description: Additional aliases to assign to the image.

options.name: architecture
options.description: Image architecture identifier.

options.name: checksum
options.description: Expected checksum of the source file for verification. Verified against the downloaded or local source file before any extraction or conversion.

options.name: checksum_algorithm
options.description: Hash algorithm used for O(checksum) verification.

options.name: client_cert
options.description: Client certificate content for remote authentication. Requires O(url) and O(client_key). Mutually exclusive with O(token) and O(client_cert_path).

options.name: client_cert_path
options.description: Client certificate path for remote authentication. Requires O(url) and O(client_key_path). Mutually exclusive with O(token) and O(client_cert).

options.name: client_key
options.description: Client key content for remote authentication. Requires O(url) and O(client_cert). Mutually exclusive with O(client_key_path).

options.name: client_key_path
options.description: Client key path for remote authentication. Requires O(url) and O(client_cert_path). Mutually exclusive with O(client_key).

options.name: force
options.description: Delete and re-import the image even when the alias already exists. Useful when the upstream source has been updated at the same URL.

options.name: project
options.description: Incus project to query.

options.name: properties
options.description: Image properties included in the metadata.

options.name: public
options.description: Make the image available to unauthenticated users.

options.name: server_cert
options.description: Server certificate content for remote verification. Requires O(url). Mutually exclusive with O(server_cert_path).

options.name: server_cert_path
options.description: Server certificate path for remote verification. Requires O(url). Mutually exclusive with O(server_cert).

options.name: socket_path
options.description: Incus Unix socket path for local connections.

options.name: source
options.description: Path to a local image file or URL to download from. Supports raw and qcow2 disk images. ZIP and xz archives are automatically extracted. Required when O(state=present) and the image does not yet exist or O(force=true).

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the image.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for downloading the source file from a URL. Only applies when O(source) is a URL.

options.name: token
options.description: Token for remote authentication. Requires O(url). Mutually exclusive with O(client_cert).

options.name: url
options.description: Remote Incus server URL (e.g. https://host:8443). If specified, connects via HTTPS instead of Unix socket.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Server TLS certificate validation.

options.name: wait
options.description: Async operation completion wait. Set to C(false) for fire-and-forget behaviour.
